{{Top|leg}}
The '''Central Clinic''' of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] was a [[Medcenter/Legends|medical]] facility used by the burgeoning [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. It was located near the settlement of [[Vornez]]. After undergoing an operation that repaired his [[Cybernetics/Legends|mechanical]] hand, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] recovered there for a time.<ref name="Lost City">''[[The Lost City of the Jedi]]''</ref>
